seoTitle: Frasier Test: Which Character Are You? (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Frasier test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Frasier, Niles, Martin, Daphne or Roz — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the snob, the regular guy, or the one who's always on a date? Answer 10 everyday questions about food, family and friends, and find out which Frasier character you are.

characters.name: Frasier Crane
characters.title: The Snob With a Heart
characters.summary: Cultured, opinionated and a little pompous. You love the finer things, but deep down you mean well.
description: Like Frasier, you have refined taste. He's a psychiatrist who hosts a call-in radio show on KACL in Seattle.
There's a good heart under all that polish. Frasier can be fussy and pompous, but he has a strong moral compass.
You follow your heart in the end. In the finale, Frasier is meant to start a new job in San Francisco, but his plane lands in Chicago, where Charlotte lives.
characters.flaw: You overthink everything until it falls apart.
characters.signature: A glass of sherry, a strong opinion and a dinner party that goes wrong.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a long lecture when you only wanted a quick answer

characters.name: Niles Crane
characters.title: The Even Bigger Snob
characters.summary: Refined, fastidious and hopelessly romantic. Your standards are sky-high, and so is your heart.
description: Like Niles, your standards are very high. He's Frasier's younger brother, also a psychiatrist, and somehow even fussier.
You like things clean. Niles is famously germ-phobic, and he wipes down chairs before he sits on them.
You're a romantic at heart. Niles falls for Daphne the moment he meets her, and years later they marry and have a son, David.
characters.flaw: You worry about everything, especially germs.
characters.signature: A pocket square, a hand wipe and a secret crush you've had for years.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly judge your taste in everything

characters.name: Martin Crane
characters.title: The Regular Guy
characters.summary: Down-to-earth, honest and allergic to fuss. You like simple things, and you say it like it is.
description: Like Martin, you keep it simple. He's a retired Seattle police detective who had to stop working after he was shot in the hip.
You love your comforts. Martin is a beer drinker, and nobody is getting him out of his battered old recliner.
You get closer to your family over time. Martin's relationship with his sons deepens over the years, and in the finale he marries Ronee.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a joke than talk about your feelings.
characters.signature: A cold beer, a ballgame on TV and the comfiest chair in the room.
characters.clashReason: they'd roll their eyes at anything that costs more than a burger

characters.name: Daphne Moon
characters.title: The Intuitive One
characters.summary: Warm, chatty and a little bit mystical. You look after everyone, and you always have a story about your family.
description: Like Daphne, you look after people. She's Martin's physical therapist, and she moves in to help him at home.
You trust your gut. Daphne believes she's a little bit psychic, and she's often right.
You come from a big, chaotic family. Daphne grew up in Manchester, England, with a difficult mother and a houseful of brothers.
characters.flaw: You overshare about your family to anyone who'll listen.
characters.signature: A pot of tea, a strange feeling about today and a story about one of your brothers.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you they had a feeling about you, and it wouldn't be a good one

characters.name: Roz Doyle
characters.title: The Confident One
characters.summary: Bold, funny and comfortable in your own skin. You say what you want, and you don't apologize for it.
description: Like Roz, you're comfortable in your own skin. She's Frasier's radio producer, originally from Bloomer, Wisconsin.
You live life your way. Roz loves dating, and she makes no apologies for it.
You can handle anything. Roz decides to raise her daughter, Alice, on her own, and by the finale she's been made station manager.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a sharp comment than admit you're hurt.
characters.signature: A headset, a sarcastic comeback and a date on Friday night.
characters.clashReason: they'd make fun of you to your face, and get a laugh out of everyone

questions.text: Friends invite you to a new restaurant. You...

options.text: Study the wine list before you even get there
Ask whether the chef trained in Paris
Ask if they do a decent burger
Go, and send back anything that isn't right

questions.text: A friend comes to you with a problem. You...

options.text: Diagnose them on the spot, whether they asked or not
Listen, then tell them a story about one of your relatives
Tell them what you'd do, in one sentence
Pour them a drink and tell them the hard truth

questions.text: It's Saturday night, and you're free. You'd choose...

options.text: A beer, the game and your favorite chair
A night out with someone new, wherever it leads
The opera, in the best seats, then a nightcap
Hosting an elegant dinner party for people you'd like to impress

questions.text: You're stuck at home with a cold. You...

options.text: Disinfect everything you've touched and call your doctor twice
Tough it out. It's just a cold
Make a pot of soup from an old family recipe
Go to work anyway. Nobody else can do your job

questions.text: Someone gives you a gift you really don't like. You...

options.text: Smile politely, then hide it somewhere they'll never see
Thank them graciously, then quietly exchange it
Say thanks. It's the thought that counts
Find a use for it. Waste not, want not

questions.text: A friend gets all the praise for something you did together. You...

options.text: Mention your part at every opportunity
Seethe quietly, and plan a very subtle revenge
Feel hurt, then forgive them over a cup of tea
Point it out once, in front of everyone

questions.text: You meet someone you really like. You...

options.text: Fall instantly, then spend years too nervous to say so
Ask them out the same night
Plan the perfect first date, and overthink it until it goes wrong
Let it happen naturally. If it's meant to be, you'll know

questions.text: Your neighbor is having a loud party on a weeknight. You...

options.text: Go over to object, and end up staying for the party
Call building management. Twice
Turn the TV up louder
Pop round with a smile, and ask nicely if they'll keep it down

questions.text: You work on a radio call-in show, and today's caller has a ridiculous problem. You...

options.text: Give them a long, thoughtful answer anyway
Cut them off and go to an ad break
Get a feeling about what's really going on with them
Ask them the questions a good detective would

questions.text: Your dad moves in with you, along with his ugly old recliner. You...

options.text: Complain constantly, but secretly love having him there
Buy him a far nicer chair, and quietly get rid of the old one
Make everyone feel at home, chair and all
Tell him the chair has to go, to his face
